name: GSA SF 91 Motor Vehicle Accident Report

crash.description: Crash details printed on the GSA Standard Form 91.

date.description: The crash date exactly as printed in field 3, DATE OF CRASH.

federal_vehicle.description: Federal vehicle details printed in Section I of the GSA Standard Form 91.

driver_name.description: The federal vehicle driver's name exactly as printed in field 1.

tag_id.description: The federal vehicle tag or identification number exactly as printed in field 5.

estimated_repair_cost.description: The federal vehicle estimated repair cost exactly as printed in field 6, preserving the decimal form as a string.

year.description: The federal vehicle model year exactly as printed in field 7.

make.description: The federal vehicle make exactly as printed in field 8.

model.description: The federal vehicle model exactly as printed in field 9.

damage.description: The federal vehicle damage description exactly as printed in field 11.

other_vehicle.description: Other vehicle details printed in Section II of the GSA Standard Form 91.

driver_name.description: The other vehicle driver's name exactly as printed in field 12.

insurance.description: The other vehicle driver's insurer details printed in field 23.

company.description: The insurance company name exactly as printed in field 23a.

policy_number.description: The insurance policy number exactly as printed in field 23b.
